meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 交付代码前先自己跑一遍人工验收,再让一名审查者逐项把关目标、约束、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次提 PR 前都担心漏掉验收步骤或质量问题
copy.tagline_en: Run your own manual QA, then one focused gate review before the PR handoff
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a consistent quality gate before every PR handoff.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先自己在真实界面上做手动 QA，再只派一个门禁评审代理，按目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文和 QA 证据审查改动；QA 无失败行且评审通过才算通过。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接前，或你明确要求评审已完成的改动时触发。

say.text: 对刚完成的改动做门禁评审
say.note: 先手动 QA，再只派一名评审代理

say.text: 评审这个分支的改动有没有达成目标
say.note: 从专用 review worktree 收集 diff

say.text: 交接 PR 前先评审一遍
say.note: QA 有失败行会直接判 REVIEW FAILED

howto.what_en: After install, Claude does manual QA on the real surface, then spawns exactly ONE gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context and QA evidence. Passes only if no QA row fails and it returns APPROVE.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff, or when you explicitly ask to review completed work. Any failing QA row ends the review before the gate reviewer runs.

say_en.text: Gate-review the work I just finished.
say_en.note: Manual QA first, then one gate reviewer

say_en.text: Review this branch's changes against the original goal.
say_en.note: Collects the diff from a dedicated review worktree

say_en.text: Review before I hand off the PR.
say_en.note: A failing QA row returns REVIEW FAILED
